string_input.label: Text input
string_input.description: Passes a fixed text on as output.

script.label: Script
script.description: Runs Python code with the previous output as input.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Turns inputs into a model request.

conditional.label: Conditional flow
conditional.description: Branches the flow based on rules.

iterative_refinement.label: Iterative refinement
iterative_refinement.description: Improves a result over several rounds.

write_file.label: Write file
write_file.description: Writes the previous output as a file.

read_email.label: Read email
read_email.description: Reads sender, subject, message and arrival time from an email trigger.

read_channel_event.label: Read message
read_channel_event.description: Reads an incoming email, WhatsApp or SMS event.

read_webhook.label: Webhook event
read_webhook.description: Reads the body, method, query and headers of the webhook call that started the task.

send_channel_message.label: Send message
send_channel_message.description: Sends a message through a connected channel.

notification_send.label: Send push notification
notification_send.description: Sends a text as a push notification to all team members.

tool_call.label: Tool call
tool_call.description: Connects external actions or data sources.

dialog_input.label: Form input
dialog_input.description: Pauses the task until a form has been filled in.

media_input.label: Request image
media_input.description: Pauses the task until an image has been taken or selected.

model_inference.label: Run model
model_inference.description: Prepares an image according to the model contract and runs a model.

text_to_speech.label: Read text aloud
text_to_speech.description: Converts text into an audio file.

speech_to_text.label: Transcribe audio
speech_to_text.description: Converts an audio file into text.

for_each.label: For each item
for_each.description: Runs a sub-plan for each item of a JSON array.

document_lookup.label: Find record
document_lookup.description: Finds a record by visible fields and conditions.

save_document.label: Save record
save_document.description: Creates a record or updates its fields.

table_from_collection.label: Collection as table
table_from_collection.description: Reads a whole data collection and passes it on as a table value.

validation.label: Validation
validation.description: Checks the result, schema or quality criteria.

http_request.label: HTTP request
http_request.description: Calls the API of an external system and passes the response on.

email.read_description: Reads sender, subject, message and arrival time from an email trigger.

whatsapp.read_description: Reads sender, message and arrival time from a WhatsApp trigger.
whatsapp.send_description: Sends a WhatsApp message through novooa.

sms.read_description: Reads sender, message and arrival time from a SMS trigger.

body.pick_left: Choose a block on the left

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the interface and of new default names.
